item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A WFP Bangladesh factsheet dated 30 October 2023 states that Bangladesh had made significant progress in improving food security and addressing malnutrition and had narrowed the poverty gap, while access to diverse and nutritious food remained difficult for many households. WFP listed programmes covering social-safety-net capacity strengthening, general food assistance, nutrition, resilience, rice fortification, school feeding, urban food security, emergency preparedness, monitoring, and governmental partnerships.","notes":["The excerpt lists programmes but does not establish that they were active or planned."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UN independent experts reported in November 2023 that Bangladesh experienced a severe crackdown against workers seeking fair wages and political activists seeking free and fair elections; arrests of senior opposition leaders, mass arbitrary detention of thousands of activists, excessive force, internet shutdowns to disrupt protests, and alleged retaliatory harassment and unlawful detention of relatives. They also reported attacks, surveillance, intimidation, and judicial harassment of the press; convictions and imprisonment of Odhikar leaders; and more than 5,600 freedom-of-expression cases still pending under the much-criticised Digital Services Act. They judged that the 2023 Cyber Security Act made only few improvements and retained many flaws threatening freedom of expression.","notes":["The excerpt calls the law the “Digital Services Act”; the summary should not replace that wording with “Digital Security Act.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
